title: Asphalt Plant Inspection Report

ratings.label: Monitor
ratings.meaning: Early wear or minor defect, recheck next visit

ratings.label: Action
ratings.meaning: Needs repair or replacement at the next planned shutdown

ratings.label: Urgent
ratings.meaning: Safety risk or likely failure: tell the customer today and fix before further production

ratings.label: N/A
ratings.meaning: Not fitted. Equipment that is fitted but out of use must be identified separately, with its inspection status stated in the comments.

safety: Permit to work / isolation in place for any close-up work
PPE worn and two-way radio carried
Hot, high and moving-plant hazards assessed

sections.title: Cold Feed
items: Hoppers and grids: wear, damage, blockages
Feeder belts and skirts: wear, tracking, spillage
Bin vibrators and gates
Collecting and transfer conveyors: bearings, belts, idlers, drums, joints, scrapers
Canopy and sheeting
Guards, E-stops and pull wires

sections.title: Dryer and Burner
items: Drum shell, seals and fencing / guards
Roller paths, support and thrust rollers
Drive: gear or chain, guards, lubrication
Dryer tracking
Condition of lifters
Burner: flame, nozzle, photocell, ignition leads
Fuel pipework, safety valves, hoses, pump and pressure gauges: leaks
Damper blades and linkage
Insulation, cladding and discharge chute
Pyrometer and pressure transducer

sections.title: Screening and Mixing Tower
items: Hot elevator: chain, buckets, casing, seals, unusual noise
Screen: mesh, mounts, V-belts, unusual noise
Hot bins: wear, gates, level probes
Aggregate, filler and bitumen weigh hoppers: seals, doors, cylinders
Load cells and mountings: damage, build-up, loose fixings
Mixer: shafts, arms, tips, liners, seals, leaks, unusual noise
Mixer motor, coupling, gearbox and discharge gate
Tower structure: platforms, stairs, handrails, guards, visibility
Dust or material leaks from casings and ducting

sections.title: Primary and Secondary Dust Collection
items: Primary collector (drop-out box or cyclone), screws, leaks
Filter casing, hoppers and ducting: holes, corrosion, leaks
Filter bags, free clean/pulse valves and air lines: visible damage, leaks
Secondary dust system, guards and screws
Exhaust fan and damper: noise, vibration, build-up
Pressure transducer
Temperature probes
Visible emissions from stack

sections.title: Imported Filler Storage Silo
items: Silo structure, ladders and platforms
Level control and safety devices
Filling line, vent and filter
Weigh and trough screws, blower, aeration, pneumatics

sections.title: Reclaimed Filler Storage Silo
items: Silo structure, ladders and platforms
Level control and safety devices
Reclaim elevator and screws
Weigh and trough screws, bellows, aeration, pneumatics

sections.title: Reclaimed Filler Purge System
items: Purge valve, screw and pipework: wear, blockages, leaks
Guards, isolators and general condition

sections.title: Dust Conditioner
items: Conditioner unit: casing, shaft seals, leaks
Feed screws and drive: guards, condition
Water or liquid supply and spray nozzles

sections.title: Additive Systems
sections.note: Cover each additive system fitted (for example fibre or pellets, hydrated lime, warm mix, wet mix, liquid additive).
items: Hoppers or silos: structure, level control, leaks
Weigh screws, rotary valves and blowers
Pumps, nozzles, pipework and heating (liquid systems)
Guards, isolators and general condition

sections.title: Bitumen Storage
items: Tank(s): insulation, cladding, access, leaks
Level gauging and safety devices (visible condition)
Heating system: heaters, thermal oil lines or controls (visible condition)
Pipework, valves and trace heating: leaks, damaged cladding
Pumps: seals and leaks
Spray bar / shower and splash guards
Bund and spill containment

sections.title: PMB Storage
items: Tank(s): insulation, cladding, access, leaks
Level gauging and safety devices (visible condition)
Heating system and pipework: leaks, damaged cladding
Pumps: seals and leaks
Bund and spill containment

sections.title: Mixed Material Storage
items: Storage silos: track, structure, gates, seals, cylinders
Silo heaters, insulation and cladding
Skip: doors, springs, wire rope, sheaves, track rails, wheels, safety stops
Winch, brake and gearbox: leaks, guards
Limit switches, slack rope sensor and Castell locks
Fencing under mixer and around winch
Load cells and weight display
Aviation light (if required)
Spillage

sections.title: Recycled Asphalt (RAP) Feed System
items: RAP hoppers and grids: wear, damage, blockages
Feeders, belts, skirts and vibrators, spillage
Conveyors and weigh conveyor: belts, idlers, scrapers
Vent fan, ductwork and entry chute: build-up, damage
Canopy, guards, E-stops and pull wires

sections.title: Control House and Motor Control Panels
items: Control house: structure, condition, air conditioning
Door interlocks, screens and alarms showing
Motor control panels: damage, dust, water ingress, labelling
Panel cooling fans and filters
Cables, trunking and glands: damaged or loose
Isolators, junction boxes and E-stops: damaged or obstructed

sections.title: Other Equipment and General Site
items: Compressor, air dryer, air lines and cylinders: leaks
Platforms, stairs, ladders and handrails (outside the areas above)
Steelwork: corrosion, cracks, loose bolts
Fencing, signage and fire extinguishers
Dust, spillage and trip hazards
Oil, fuel or bitumen leaks

items.t: Any other equipment not covered above (describe)
